units.text: First, our goal was to convert all revenue streams largely to SaaS recurring revenue.
Since 2020, we have converted over $7 million in one-time revenue to recurring SaaS and increased our recurring revenue from 62% of total revenue to over 98%.
Since 2020, we have paid off over $6 million in bank debt and reduced annual operating expenses from roughly $19 million to $16 million.
Meanwhile, we have grown our net margin from 8% to north of 30% during the same period.

provenance.source: US SEC EDGAR, Form 8-K filed 2026-02-19 by ReposiTrak, Inc. (CIK 50471), Exhibit 99.2, transcript of the second quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call held 2026-02-17
provenance.speaker: Chief Financial Officer, prepared remarks on milestones since 2020
